title: EBI-Metagenomics/mgnifams pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and may only contain letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'

protein_input.description: run_mgnifams_pipeline: protein FASTA already sliced as wanted (e.g. update_mgnifams' update_families/mgnifams_update.faa); instead of mgnify_proteins_sequences
protein_input.errorMessage: Must be a .fa, .fasta or .faa file, optionally gzipped.

results_folder.description: Results (outdir) of the mgnifams pipeline to import into the database: run_mgnifams_pipeline for init/update_mgnifams_db, update_mgnifams for post_update_mgnifams_update_db.

schema.description: The sqlite schema file with the database table creation queries

mgnprotein_db_config.description: The mgnify proteins database config file with secrets (update_mgnifams_db, which checks it exists; deprecated and ignored in update_mgnifams)

mgnify_proteins_sequences.description: update_mgnifams: MGnify protein sequences parquet (protein_id, sequence). run_mgnifams_pipeline: instead of protein_input, its Pfam-free slices are the input

mgnify_proteins_clusters.description: update_mgnifams, run_mgnifams_pipeline: MGnify protein clusters parquet (cluster_rep, cluster_rep_biomes); only the cluster representatives are sliced and searched, and give the members' biomes. rebuild_biomes: the same parquet, for the members' biomes

mgnify_proteins_pfam.description: update_mgnifams, run_mgnifams_pipeline: MGnify protein Pfam hits parquet (protein_id, pfam_accession, i_evalue, score, hmm_from, hmm_to, env_from, env_to): the regions sliced off, and the members' domain architectures

mgnifams_hmms.description: update_mgnifams: HMM library of the existing MGnifams (NAME = family id)
mgnifams_hmms.errorMessage: Must be a .hmm/.lib file, optionally gzipped.

mgnifams_families.description: update_mgnifams: families.tsv.gz of the MGnifams release being updated (its FTP release folder). annotate_not_updated: families.tsv.gz of a finished update; its not_updated families are re-annotated

reps_fasta.description: annotate_not_updated, update_mgnifams (optional): FASTA of the previous family representatives, headers starting with the family id

structures.description: annotate_not_updated, update_mgnifams (optional): folder of the previous representatives' structures, <family_id>.pdb

refined_families.description: rebuild_biomes: update_families/refined_families.tsv of a finished update (family<TAB>member, the updated families only)

biome_results.description: post_update_mgnifams_update_db (optional): biome_results folder (<family_id>.csv) of a rebuild_biomes run; replaces <results_folder>/biome_results and implies biome_computed

mgnifam_regions.description: run_mgnifams_pipeline (optional): folder of MGnifam region files (*.tsv, family<TAB>MGYP/start-end, a bare MGYP = the whole protein), masked from the input like the Pfam regions
